title: prototype-board 旧输出单元不匹配当前 task 时不可出图
prompt: 当前 run 已有新任务 revision，但 prototype-board 只有旧 task 的 3 个输出单元时，readiness 必须视为暂无当前方案。

required_behaviors: 旧输出单元不计入当前方案数量
readiness 显示 prototype-board 暂无当前页面输出单元
forbidden_behaviors: 用旧 board 的 3 个方案满足本轮
把旧输出单元绑定到新 brief
绕过方案方向确认写 prompt

command:
tmp=$(mktemp -d); export PMW_HOME="$tmp" PMW_PROJECT_SLUG=old-board; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, pathlib
root=pathlib.Path(os.environ['PMW_HOME'])/'projects'/os.environ['PMW_PROJECT_SLUG']; (root/'runs').mkdir(parents=True)
brief=root/'brief.md'; brief.write_text('确认状态：已对齐\n不可虚构：不能展示真实收益承诺\n', encoding='utf-8')
proj={'slug':os.environ['PMW_PROJECT_SLUG'],'current_run_id':'run1','latest_run_id':'run1','latest_run_status':'已开始','current_task_digest':'digest-new','current_input_revision':'rev-new','latest_brief':str(brief),'latest_brief_version':'v1'}
(root/'project.json').write_text(json.dumps(proj, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8')
(root/'artifact-flow.jsonl').write_text(json.dumps({'kind':'product_brief','run_id':'run1','status':'已对齐','path':str(brief),'task_digest':'digest-new','input_revision':'rev-new'}, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
(root/'runs'/'run1.jsonl').write_text(json.dumps({'event':'decision','run_id':'run1','status':'已对齐','title':'产品简报确认','summary':'确认','task_digest':'digest-new','input_revision':'rev-new'}, ensure_ascii=False)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
rows=[]
for s in ['A','B','C']:
 rows.append({'record_type':'item','run_id':'run1','scheme':s,'screen':'首屏','brief_path':str(brief),'brief_version':'v1','task_digest':'digest-old','input_revision':'rev-old','product_path':'旧方案','behavior_assumption':'旧','current_loss':'旧','tradeoff':'旧','design_score':'8','design_gap':'旧','ten_out_of_ten_standard':'旧','prompt_design_fix':'旧','anti_ai_slop_constraints':'旧','state_coverage':'旧','first_second_third_hierarchy':'旧','design_spec_target':'PMW 默认假设','design_system_profile':'默认','platform_pattern':'不适用','no_copy_boundary':'不复制'})
(root/'prototype-board.jsonl').write_text('\n'.join(json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) for r in rows)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
PY
bin/pmw-dashboard readiness --target prototype --json
contains: prototype-board 暂无页面输出单元
prototype-board 暂无当前 run 输出单元
